stories.title: NASA, University of Texas Expand Research and Workforce Development
stories.summary: NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston and the University of Texas System (UT System) announced the signing of a collaborative Space Act Agreement on Jan. 9, 2026. The agreement expands research and workforce development partnership opportunities across NASA centers and UT System facilities. stories.title: Atmospheric H<sub>2</sub> variability over the past 1,100 years
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 04 February 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10099-1Analysis of the atmospheric H2 variability over the past millennium suggests that the sensitivity of H2 to climate change should be considered in estimates of the radiative consequences of rising anthropogenic H2 emissions.
